FIELDS.NAME: Flooring Solutions Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Flooring Solutions Co., we specialize in the installation of residential and light commercial flooring, including carpet, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl. Our operations encompass a thorough process that begins with assessing client needs, providing material selections, and executing installations using only pre-manufactured and non-toxic flooring materials sourced from certified suppliers. We ensure that all employees are adequately trained and that safety protocols are adhered to on every job site. 

Additionally, we are committed to maintaining compliance with all legal requirements, including having the necessary licenses and worker's compensation policies in place. Our team also conducts post-installation inspections to guarantee quality, while customer satisfaction is paramount, and we provide warranties for both workmanship and materials. We utilize secure digital systems for scheduling and invoicing and fully align with industry best practices to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Residential Flooring Solutions LLC, a subsidiary focused on eco-friendly flooring alternatives.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 01/10/2023; Cause: Damage during installation of residential carpet due to improper securing of materials; Amount: $1,200; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present at job sites to oversee installations and enhance safety protocols.
